title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Build 283 (Previous Balance Option & Fast Billing Reset)
highlights: Customer Previous Balance on Invoices & Quotations: Optional toggle in Invoice Settings (முந்தைய பாக்கி, default OFF) to display customer previous outstanding balance and total net due across A4, A5, and Thermal prints.
1-Click Direct Document Deletion: Added direct Delete action button in Document Manager rows for immediate invoice deletion and stock replenishment with 1-click confirmation.

Instant Clean Billing Reset: After Preview & Save or closing invoice preview, screen automatically resets cleanly to a fresh blank invoice with the next sequential number and auto-focuses on barcode/search.
fixes: Added showPreviousBalance configuration in invoice print preferences and database.
Integrated CustomerCreditRepository previous balance calculation in InvoicePrintService and CompactInvoicePrintService.
Added direct Delete button in sales_document_manager table rows.
Clean invoice form reset and auto-focus after Preview & Save.
Updated Build 283 Windows installer and Android release packages.
